title: Procurement Budget & Emergency Sourcing Rules — Q2 2026

emergency_sourcing_cap.approval_required: Operations Director sign-off above this cap

expedited_freight_cap.scope: per shipment for air or premium ground freight

minimum_supplier_reliability.scope: any new purchase order must originate from supplier with reliability ≥ threshold
minimum_supplier_reliability.exceptions: Operations Director can waive on documented emergency

stock_safety_floor.scope: do not allow on-hand to fall below per-SKU safety floor without alert

notes: All emergency sourcing actions must be logged in the Saga Ledger with reserve→commit/refund semantics. No simple deduction allowed.
